gap:logistic_fitting.statement: Implement precise logistic regression fitting with 5-fold CV, lambda tuning, interaction features, and model compression to answer three specific predictive questions.

claim:lambda_tuning.statement: L2 regularization lambda=0.1 achieves the lowest 5-fold CV Brier score (0.2071) among tested values, with improvement of 0.0089 over baseline lambda=0.

claim:interaction_features.statement: Adding interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improves model performance. Paired t-test across 5 folds shows t-statistic=3.91 (>2.0), indicating interaction features help reduce Brier score by mean 0.0257.

claim:compression.statement: Among compression configurations tested, sparsity20_bits4 achieves the highest retention (0.9992) of dense model performance, retaining Brier score of 0.1419 vs dense 0.1418.
